interfaces.circuit: R/C/L, independent V/I (DC/AC/PWL), numeric diode and voltage-controlled release switch fixtures, one DUT with task-defined pins
interfaces.analysis: DC sweep, single-frequency or bounded linear AC sweep, transient
interfaces.measurement: sample, dc_current_max (max absolute input current), dc_current_difference (actual probe difference), dc_slope, dc_sensitivity_error_percent, dc_linearity_percent, curve, ratio_curve (actual V/I), capacitance, complex V/I impedance/ESR/C/L/loss and voltage-ratio gain/dB/phase, integral_to_crossing with explicit integration start and target
interfaces.forbidden: arbitrary Python/shell, external model files, changes to immutable reference/acceptance/ports
